body: Implemented and verified the in-assistant Plantool integration: scoped JSON lookup via argument-array subprocess with the Mastra project root as cwd; explicit latest-user authorization for task creation, ticket updates, and comments; duplicate-title reuse; and protection for person-owned decisions. Verified with 5 Plantool tests, TypeScript check, 15 task/policy tests, and Plantool validate/check. This note is visible in plantool serve.
